operations.text: 0.3.5 lets a planning session run beside an executing one: while .aiwf/route-state.json names an R2/R3 ticket, Gate 3 now also lets the main session write every file under <plansDir>/drafts/** and <plansDir>/readiness/**, with <plansDir> held to the transfer surface's containment terms (not absolute, no '..', inside the project, never under .claude) and nothing opened while the route state is unusable. So /pnp:plan (draft, stamp, readiness rounds) can run in a second session while a ticket is open; landed plans under <plansDir>/active/ stay behind the guard. One paid review pass is in flight per working tree at a time, held by the operator: the review brief and the session files are shared. This update writes only the two version stamps in your config's bookkeeping (installedPluginVersion, lastMigrationApplied); the hook is payload, read at every tool call, so no file of yours changes.
